───────────────────────────────
   FRESH IDEAS TRACKER
───────────────────────────────
Created: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Last Updated: <YYYY-MM-DD>

Purpose:
This tracker captures every "new" idea—whether it’s a product feature, process improvement, marketing angle, or anything else—to keep them organized, prioritized, and actionable.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
| # | Idea Title          | Category      | Owner | Target Launch |
|---|---------------------|---------------|-------|--------------|
| 1 |                     |               |       |              |
| 2 |                     |               |       |              |
|…  | …                   | …             | …     | …            |

Status Legend:
• 🟢 In Review – Idea has been vetted & needs next steps
• 🔵 Under Development – Work underway
• ⚪️ On Hold – Waiting on resources/approval
• ❌ Rejected – Not moving forward

Notes / Comments Section:
(Use this area to add context, links, sketches, stakeholder feedback, etc.)

Action Items Checklist:
✔︎ Assign owner
✔︎ Define acceptance criteria
✔︎ Set milestone dates
✔︎ Schedule review meeting

-----------------------------------------------------------------

How to use:
1️⃣ Add each new concept as soon as it surfaces.
2️⃣ Update the status regularly so everyone knows where things stand.
3️⃣ At weekly syncs, pull the top‑prioritized ideas for deeper discussion.

Feel free to tweak column names or add extra columns (like "Impact Score", "Risk Level") based on your team’s workflow.

Happy ideating!
", "file_name": "TeamNotes.txt"}

### Why this happened  

When I added Simona’s quote to `TeamNotes.txt` I used the `echo` command with the `file_name` argument. By default `echo` **overwrites** the target file rather than appends to it. Since `TeamNotes.txt` already contained the full “Fresh Ideas Tracker” template, my latest call replaced the whole file with just the quoted sentence.

That explains why the two files look different before the update (one was a rich template, the other a short note) and why they appear the same afterward—they were overwritten during the last write.

---

If you want to keep the original template while still recording the quote, either:

   echo "Collaboration leads to success. Innovation ignites growth." >> TeamNotes.txt
   ```
2. Or **create a separate section** inside the template dedicated to quotes/inspirations.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed!
